Merge pull request #1011 from mockito/sf

Tidy-up in build automation

Tidy-up in IDE setup

Removed unnecessary manipulation of the IDEA ipr file. We can use built-in 'vcs' method to configure the version control system for the project. This way, the build is simpler.

Tested by regenerating IDEA configuration and loading to IntelliJ, vcs was correctly set up.

Tidy-up in the build automation

Removed unnecessary 'provided' configuration. Gradle 2.12 introduced 'compileOnly' configuration that can be used instead. This way, we can clean up our build script and avoid unnecessary build logic.

Testing done:
- ran build, tests pass, jars are created, things look good
- ran old build and new build, compared build dirs, eyeballed binaries and javadocs, seem good.
- recreated idea configuration with “./gradlew cleanIdea idea”, loaded to IntelliJ, rebuilt project in IDEA, ran tests from all submodules, all good.
- cleaned idea configuration with “./gardlew cleanIdea”, then loaded to IDEA using IntelliJ-own Gradle support
